evidence.quote: if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) throw new Error('Quantity must be a positive integer');

answer.rationale: PlaceOrder duplicates the Quantity invariant (positive integer) that the Quantity constructor already enforces. This is a business rule copy in an application service, not pure input parsing. The unit price check (non-negative whole cents) is likewise a rule the Money value object should own.
